variants.headline: Government cannot pay its debts
variants.body: The government of {colony} cannot pay its debts. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: Public debt meets a payment failure
variants.body: The colony's government is unable to pay its debts. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: The colony's government faces default
variants.body: Government debt in the colony cannot be paid by the administration. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
